blocks.title: A Wise Woman Builds Her House

texts.NIV84: The wise woman builds her house, but with her own hands the foolish one tears hers down.
texts.KJV: Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.
texts.NKJV:
The wise woman builds her house,
But the foolish pulls it down with her hands.
texts.DRB: A wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish will pull down with her hands that also which is built.

texts.NIV84: He whose walk is upright fears the LORD, but he whose ways are devious despises him.
texts.KJV: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the Lord: but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.
texts.NKJV:
He who walks in his uprightness fears the Lord,
But he who is perverse in his ways despises Him.
texts.DRB: He that walketh in the right way, and feareth God, is despised by him that goeth by an infamous way.

texts.NIV84: A fool's talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.
texts.KJV: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.
texts.NKJV:
In the mouth of a fool is a rod of pride,
But the lips of the wise will preserve them.
texts.DRB: In the mouth of a fool is the rod of pride: but the lips of the wise preserve them.

texts.NIV84: Where there are no oxen, the manger is empty, but from the strength of an ox comes an abundant harvest.
texts.KJV: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
texts.NKJV:
Where no oxen are, the trough is clean;
But much increase comes by the strength of an ox.
texts.DRB: Where there are no oxen, the crib is empty: but where there is much corn, there the strength of the ox is manifest.

blocks.title: A Scoffer Seeking Wisdom Does Not Find It

texts.NIV84: A truthful witness does not deceive, but a false witness pours out lies.
texts.KJV: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.
texts.NKJV:
A faithful witness does not lie,
But a false witness will utter lies.
texts.DRB: A faithful witness will not lie: but a deceitful witness uttereth a lie.

texts.NIV84: The mocker seeks wisdom and finds none, but knowledge comes easily to the discerning.
texts.KJV: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth.
texts.NKJV:
A scoffer seeks wisdom and does not find it,
But knowledge is easy to him who understands.
texts.DRB: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: the learning of the wise is easy.

texts.NIV84: Stay away from a foolish man, for you will not find knowledge on his lips.
texts.KJV: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.
texts.NKJV:
Go from the presence of a foolish man,
When you do not perceive in him the lips of knowledge.
texts.DRB: Go against a foolish man, and he knoweth not the lips of prudence.

texts.NIV84: The wisdom of the prudent is to give thought to their ways, but the folly of fools is deception.
texts.KJV: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.
texts.NKJV:
The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way,
But the folly of fools is deceit.
texts.DRB: The wisdom of a. discreet man is to understand his way: and the imprudence of fools erreth.

texts.NIV84: Fools mock at making amends for sin, but goodwill is found among the upright.
texts.KJV: Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous there is favour.
texts.NKJV:
Fools mock at sin,
But among the upright there is favor.
texts.DRB: A fool will laugh at sin, but among the just grace shall abide.

blocks.title: A Good Man is Satisfied From Above

texts.NIV84: Each heart knows its own bitterness, and no one else can share its joy.
texts.KJV: The heart knoweth his own bitterness; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy.
texts.NKJV:
The heart knows its own bitterness,
And a stranger does not share its joy.
texts.DRB: The heart that knoweth the bitterness of his own soul, in his joy the stranger shall not intermeddle.

texts.NIV84: The house of the wicked will be destroyed, but the tent of the upright will flourish.
texts.KJV: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.
texts.NKJV:
The house of the wicked will be overthrown,
But the tent of the upright will flourish.
texts.DRB: The house of the wicked shall be destroyed: but the tabernacles of the just shall flourish.

texts.NIV84: There is a way that seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
texts.KJV: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
texts.NKJV:
There is a way that seems right to a man,
But its end is the way of death.
texts.DRB: There is a way which seemeth just to a man: but the ends thereof lead to death.

texts.NIV84: Even in laughter the heart may ache, and joy may end in grief.
texts.KJV: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.
texts.NKJV:
Even in laughter the heart may sorrow,
And the end of mirth may be grief.
texts.DRB: Laughter shall be mingled with sorrow, and mourning taketh hold of the end of joy.

texts.NIV84: The faithless will be fully repaid for their ways, and the good man rewarded for his.
texts.KJV: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man shall be satisfied from himself.
texts.NKJV:
The backslider in heart will be filled with his own ways,
But a good man will be satisfied from above.
texts.DRB: A fool shall be filled with his own ways, and the good man shall be above him.

blocks.title: A Wise Man Departs From Evil

texts.NIV84: A simple man believes anything, but a prudent man gives thought to his steps.
texts.KJV: The simple believeth every word: but the prudent man looketh well to his going.
texts.NKJV:
The simple believes every word,
But the prudent considers well his steps.
texts.DRB: The innocent believeth every word: the discreet man considereth his steps. No good shall come to the deceitful son: but the wise servant shall prosper in his dealings, and his way shall be made straight.

texts.NIV84: A wise man fears the LORD and shuns evil, but a fool is hotheaded and reckless.
texts.KJV: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.
texts.NKJV:
A wise man fears and departs from evil,
But a fool rages and is self-confident.
texts.DRB: A wise man feareth and declineth from evil: the fool leapeth over and is confident.

texts.NIV84: A quick-tempered man does foolish things, and a crafty man is hated.
texts.KJV: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.
texts.NKJV:
A quick-tempered man acts foolishly,
And a man of wicked intentions is hated.
texts.DRB: The impatient man shall work folly: and the crafty man is hateful.

texts.NIV84: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
texts.KJV: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
texts.NKJV:
The simple inherit folly,
But the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
texts.DRB: The childish shall possess folly, and the prudent, shall look for knowledge.

texts.NIV84: Evil men will bow down in the presence of the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
texts.KJV: The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
texts.NKJV:
The evil will bow before the good,
And the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
texts.DRB: The evil shall fall down before the good: and the wicked before the gates of the just.

texts.NIV84: The poor are shunned even by their neighbors, but the rich have many friends.
texts.KJV: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich hath many friends.
texts.NKJV:
The poor man is hated even by his own neighbor,
But the rich has many friends.
texts.DRB: The poor man shall be hateful even to his own neighbour: but the friends of the rich are many.

texts.NIV84: He who despises his neighbor sins, but blessed is he who is kind to the needy.
texts.KJV: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy is he.
texts.NKJV:
He who despises his neighbor sins;
But he who has mercy on the poor, happy is he.
texts.DRB: He that despiseth his neighbour, sinneth: but he that sheweth mercy to the poor, shall be blessed. He that believeth in the Lord, loveth mercy.

texts.NIV84: Do not those who plot evil go astray? But those who plan what is good find love and faithfulness.
texts.KJV: Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.
texts.NKJV:
Do they not go astray who devise evil?
But mercy and truth belong to those who devise good.
texts.DRB: They err that work evil: but mercy and truth prepare good things.

texts.NIV84: All hard work brings a profit, but mere talk leads only to poverty.
texts.KJV: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
texts.NKJV:
In all labor there is profit,
But idle chatter leads only to poverty.
texts.DRB: In much work there shall be abundance: but where there are many words, there is oftentimes want.

texts.NIV84: The wealth of the wise is their crown, but the folly of fools yields folly.
texts.KJV: The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.
texts.NKJV:
The crown of the wise is their riches,
But the foolishness of fools is folly.
texts.DRB: The crown of the wise is their riches: the folly of fools, imprudence.

texts.NIV84: A truthful witness saves lives, but a false witness is deceitful.
texts.KJV: A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful witness speaketh lies.
texts.NKJV:
A true witness delivers souls,
But a deceitful witness speaks lies.
texts.DRB: A faithful witness delivereth souls: and the double dealer uttereth lies.

texts.NIV84: He who fears the LORD has a secure fortress, and for his children it will be a refuge.
texts.KJV: In the fear of the Lord is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.
texts.NKJV:
In the fear of the Lord there is strong confidence,
And His children will have a place of refuge.
texts.DRB: In the fear of the Lord is confidence of strength, and there shall be hope for his children.

texts.NIV84: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, turning a man from the snares of death.
texts.KJV: The fear of the Lord is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
texts.NKJV:
The fear of the Lord is a fountain of life,
To turn one away from the snares of death.
texts.DRB: The fear of the Lord is a fountain of life, to decline from the ruin of death.

blocks.title: A Sound Heart is Life to the Body

texts.NIV84: A large population is a king's glory, but without subjects a prince is ruined.
texts.KJV: In the multitude of people is the king's honour: but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.
texts.NKJV:
In a multitude of people is a king’s honor,
But in the lack of people is the downfall of a prince.
texts.DRB: In the multitude of people is the dignity of the king: and in the small number of people the dishonour of the prince.

texts.NIV84: A patient man has great understanding, but a quick-tempered man displays folly.
texts.KJV: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.
texts.NKJV:
He who is slow to wrath has great understanding,
But he who is impulsive exalts folly.
texts.DRB: He that is patient, is governed with much wisdom: but he that is impatient, exalteth his folly.

texts.NIV84: A heart at peace gives life to the body, but envy rots the bones.
texts.KJV: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.
texts.NKJV:
A sound heart is life to the body,
But envy is rottenness to the bones.
texts.DRB: Soundness of heart is the life of the flesh: but envy is the rottenness of the bones.

texts.NIV84: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for their Maker, but whoever is kind to the needy honors God.
texts.KJV: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.
texts.NKJV:
He who oppresses the poor reproaches his Maker,
But he who honors Him has mercy on the needy.
texts.DRB: He that oppresseth the poor, upbraideth his Maker: but he that hath pity on the poor, honoureth him.

texts.NIV84: When calamity comes, the wicked are brought down, but even in death the righteous have a refuge.
texts.KJV: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.
texts.NKJV:
The wicked is banished in his wickedness,
But the righteous has a refuge in his death.
texts.DRB: The wicked man shall be driven out in his wickedness: but the just hath hope in his death.

texts.NIV84: Wisdom reposes in the heart of the discerning and even among fools she lets herself be known.
texts.KJV: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but that which is in the midst of fools is made known.
texts.NKJV:
Wisdom rests in the heart of him who has understanding,
But what is in the heart of fools is made known.
texts.DRB: In the heart of the prudent resteth wisdom, and it shall instruct all the ignorant.

texts.NIV84: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.
texts.KJV: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.
texts.NKJV:
Righteousness exalts a nation,
But sin is a reproach to any people.
texts.DRB: Justice exalteth a nation: but sin maketh nations miserable.

texts.NIV84: A king delights in a wise servant, but a shameful servant incurs his wrath.
texts.KJV: The king's favour is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is against him that causeth shame.
texts.NKJV:
The king’s favor is toward a wise servant,
But his wrath is against him who causes shame.
texts.DRB: A wise servant is acceptable to the king: he that is good for nothing shall feel his anger.
